description: Detect unfavorable planetary combinations (doshas) in a birth chart. Mangal Dosha checks Mars in houses 1,2,4,7,8,12 (affects marriage — BPHS Ch. 80 vv. 47-49 / Stri Jataka). Kaal Sarp detects all planets enclosed between Rahu-Ketu axis. Sade Sati tracks Saturn 7.5-year transit over natal Moon (3 phases). Pitru checks ancestral karma. Nadi checks pulse compatibility. "all" runs Mangal+Kaal Sarp+Pitru together. Cost: $0.016-0.040/call.

ayanamsa.description: Sidereal zodiac correction. Default: lahiri. Only for Vedic calculations.

datetime.description: Birth date and time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. "1990-06-15T14:30:00". Required for all chart calculations.

latitude.description: Birth location latitude (-90 to 90). Polar latitudes >66.5 are rejected (house calculations unreliable).

timezone.description: Timezone as UTC offset "+05:30" or IANA "Asia/Kolkata". UTC offsets preferred.

type.description: Dosha type. mangal=Mars dosha (Manglik). kaal-sarp=Rahu-Ketu axis. pitru=ancestral. nadi=Nadi incompatibility. all=combined. sade-sati=Saturn transit. sade-sati-advanced=with BPHS remedies.

name: vedika_doshas
